studies.title: Precision
studies.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: LCL game aesthetic exploration, single wide landscape scene.
Input image: sole EDIT TARGET is Opaque Signal, the technology-redesigned Bowl Watch scene.
Primary request: Make this scene SUPER CLEAN with low visual density, so each surviving functional detail has high contrast and meaning. This is a complete deliberate redesign of surface/detail hierarchy, not a sharpen/despeckle filter.
Composition invariants: Keep the exact overhead three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel camera, same landscape framing and architecture, continuous floor/path space, piers, staircase/gallery and rails, bowl shelf and bench, serving bank and overhead supply pipe, right repair station. Keep exactly FIVE people at the same positions and scale, FOUR holding bowls, fifth repairing at right; retain FOUR open articulated trays and bowls. Keep solemn mature human proportions and natural gestures, no cartoon baby bodies.
Detail hierarchy: replace the noisy floor with large quiet slate slabs with only a few structural joints; remove ALL mottled paint, grit, granular concrete, procedural noise, scratches, rust, patchy wear, hairline cracks, flecks and repeated tiny fasteners/text. Piers/walls are smooth broad neutral shapes. Neutral cloth has a few designed folds instead of wrinkle noise. Simplify pipe collars to few purposeful connections. Simplify each of four utility modules into rounded cream panels with clear seams at access doors, one distinctive opening/tray, one green state lens and a clear coral upper band. Only a few selected controls, handles, vent slots and screw heads clustered at the right maintenance cassette may remain. One dark inset diagnostic screen with a SIMPLE sparse diagram instead of the noisy globe texture. Preserve physical functionality and useful service access; avoid featureless white boxes. Bowl rims, hands and machine openings should be standout details. Simplify lamps to clean purposeful fixtures with the same locations.
Palette and lighting invariants: retain restrained slate/graphite architecture, bone cream enamel, dark brown cloth/wood, oxide-coral panel/collar/garment accents, small warm amber task lights and green status indicators. Keep the dark value structure and readable purposeful local pools; do not brighten the entire hall or create white-paper margins. Coral is surface paint and dyed trim, never glowing fog. Matte broad materials, no metallic gloss everywhere. Distinct wood/cloth/enamel by design and shading rather than dense texture.
Avoid new props or story events; no copied labels/logos, captions, UI, border, horizon, camera tilt, floating diorama, cinematic depth-of-field, photo grain or microtexture. ONE landscape image, no contact sheet.
Specific medium: super-clean stylized matte modeled/prerendered game background. Smooth broad surfaces and restrained continuous form shading, subtle soft ambient occlusion only where objects meet. Clear selected bevels and crafted industrial silhouettes. Sparse detail islands, generous quiet fields. Zero visible brushwork/paper. The scene must be materially much cleaner and less busy than the input, not simply more saturated or sharper.
studies.observations: Retains five people, four trays and hall/camera anchors. Smooth panels and broad floor slabs replace mottled wear; small fasteners, labels and most vents removed. Inset display simplified to a sparse circle diagram. Bowls, hands, tray rims, lamp fixtures and service controls stand out. Floor still has subtle texture/reflection and regular seams; some apparel folds and lamp cage detail remain. Fine module/pillar joints redesigned. Cleaner matte modeling achieved, not entirely texture-free.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Input: exact edit target is the supplied clean Graphic draft.
One targeted correction: replace the smooth continuous 3D/illustrated shading with STRICT FLAT GRAPHIC COLOUR PLANES. Make this genuinely graphically different, not merely a slightly simpler 3D render. Keep absolutely ALL content, camera, framing, object locations, five people, four trays, palette and major detail design unchanged.
Enforce a maximum of THREE opaque flat solid colour values per material, and hard polygonal/silhouette boundaries between values. Large entire floor and pier faces share flat uninterrupted fill. NO smooth gradients anywhere on architecture, machinery or clothes. NO soft ambient occlusion, photographic bounce, glossy floor reflections, watercolor, brush noise, canvas grain, repeated tiny detail, global comic outlines or lighting haze. Amber light is represented by a few clearly designed flat warm-colour polygon patches; no glowy blur. Dark shadows form a few coherent flat masses. Pipe cylinders remain rounded in silhouette but shade in only 3 solid bands, not continuously. Lamp fixtures have crisp small selected details. Human faces/hands and robe folds are simple readable coloured shapes, no portrait rendering or extra facial detail.
Keep mood sombre and graphic with deep charcoal/slate, cream utility panels, oxide-coral accent bands, tiny green status lights and muted amber pools. Keep all functional openings and the repair cassette as focal detail clusters. Retain the same overhead three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel grounded hall, no horizon/diorama/new prop. No captions or watermark. Single landscape image. This is a flat-colour architectural game illustration with mature human shapes.
